prompts: Generate a single panoramic Nexus mod header inspired by the TWO supplied reference images: intentionally homemade MS Paint doodle aesthetic on pure white, and very simple readable typography. Subject is a Skyrim THIRD PERSON CAMERA SMOOTHING MOD, NOT parkour or followers. Wide short banner approximately 1300x372. Handdrawn thin irregular pastel blue lines, light pink handwritten title exactly 'Smooth camera movement' across upper left. On the left one cute simple stick adventurer wearing a tiny purple horned helmet, running along a wavy gray ground line; in the middle a tiny handdrawn camera icon follows along a graceful pastel pink curved dashed path with a small arrow; on the right a little plain rectangular view frame with the same helmeted adventurer comfortably centered and a couple of childlike mountains behind. Charming amateur doodle like someone's lovingly drawn Paint mod thumbnail, lots of white breathing room, playful expressive face, deliberately simple imperfect outlines. Explain smooth third-person camera following visually, not acrobatics. Do not use Follower Parkour or MergeMapper wording. No realistic fantasy painting, no rendering, no gradients, no polished vector icons, no complex diagram, no branding name since mod name is not decided. One finished flat white banner, no mockup or border.

Generate a single extremely minimal panoramic Nexus mod header using the supplied references as style guides, particularly the plain MergeMapper text-on-white reference and the pastel amateur Paint doodle reference. White background, very wide short approximately 1300x372. Large crisp regular-weight black sans-serif text exactly 'Third-person camera' positioned left of center with generous whitespace. Under it smaller plain text exactly 'Smooth movement. Simple control.' On the far right, one tiny charming handdrawn pastel-blue stick adventurer seen from behind with a purple horned helmet, and a small simple camera doodle behind them connected by one curved pastel pink line. Sparse, understated, casual homemade mod page visual, no decorative frame, no shadow, no gradient, no landscape painting, no photorealism, no 3D, no UI screenshot. Keep typography beautifully readable, main label unambiguous, illustration intentionally naive with irregular strokes. Do not use the words MergeMapper or Follower Parkour. No invented final brand name. Produce one complete banner only.
